X 早报 · 2026-11-03（周二）

概览

今天是美国中期选举投票日，盖洛普调查显示经济、医疗和伊朗是选民最关心的议题。地缘方面消息密集：《华尔街日报》称美军在选举前夜打击了霍尔木兹海峡上的格什姆岛，但同时也有美伊在核计划和冻结资金上各让一步的报道；特朗普又称已与内塔尼亚胡达成协议，2026 年底停止每年 40 亿美元的对以援助，油价随之转跌。AI 基础设施继续烧钱：五大科技公司表外支出承诺达创纪录的 3.3 万亿美元，银行工商业贷款同比增 11.4%，Meta 发债 150 亿美元；Anthropic S-1 显示单季营收 170 亿美元。存储与晶圆厂动作频繁：Solidigm 拟在纽约投 1000 亿美元建 NAND 厂，SK 海力士洽谈租用英特尔俄亥俄工厂，三星泰勒二厂已被 AMD 和英伟达订满；英伟达要求云厂商至少 51% 服务卖给非中国客户。财报方面，Palantir 营收大增但因订单放缓跌 9%，Shopify 营收略逊跌超 15%，DigitalOcean、辉瑞、法拉利表现亮眼；今晚 AMD 公布财报。

伊朗、以色列与地缘政治

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：特朗普总统表示，他已与以色列总理内塔尼亚胡达成协议，美国将在 2026 年底停止向以色列付款。
特朗普称，美国目前每年向以色列提供 40 亿美元。
消息传出后，美国油价抹去涨幅并转跌。
“他们对此没有意见，”特朗普说。

原文：BREAKING: President Trump says he has made a deal with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu for the US to discontinue payments to Israel at the end of 2026.
Trump says the US currently gives Israel $4 billion per year.

突发：据《华尔街日报》报道，美军袭击了伊朗的格什姆岛。
重要细节：
– 格什姆岛正位于霍尔木兹海峡之上，这一咽喉要道承载着全球约五分之一的石油运输
– 伊朗官方媒体报道，周一深夜接连发生数次爆炸。伊朗国家通讯社（IRNA）的目击者称看到两架飞机飞过岛屿上空。法尔斯通讯社报道，阿巴斯港附近的伦格港另有爆炸，声音来自海面方向
– 美国官员称这些是“防御性打击”，旨在削弱伊朗袭击商船的能力。一名官员表示，打击目标是“使用地对空导弹攻击美国资产的伊朗人”
– 这并非孤立事件。《华尔街日报》称，这是近几周一系列有限打击中的最新一次，刻意保持小规模、低调，以免看起来像是全面军事行动的重启
– 打击发生在美国中期选举前夜，而此前特朗普曾表示周二之前不会有打击
– 特朗普同一天表示：“我们和伊朗打过一场战争，我们赢了。”他还说，他不确定这还能不能称作战争，“因为我们已经好几个月没打仗了”
– 据报道，卡塔尔调解人正带着新方案返回德黑兰，伊朗安全事务负责人穆赫辛·雷扎伊称美方的语气是“非常好的信号”
– 新任最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊表示，任何回应都应当是即时的，并且“没有地理限制”
– 美国中央司令部尚未置评，伊朗方面也尚无官方回应
– 油价几乎没有反应。布伦特原油上涨 0.5% 至 105.25 美元，WTI 原油上涨 0.5% 至 96.93 美元
我会持续更新。请开启通知关注，以免错过任何消息，这件事非常重要。

原文：BREAKING: The US military struck Iran's Qeshm Island, per WSJ.
Important details:
– Qeshm sits directly on the Strait of Hormuz, the chokepoint for roughly a fifth of the world's oil
– Iranian state media reported several explosions in rapid succession late Monday. IRNA witnesses described two planes over the island. Fars reported separate explosions at the port of Bandar Lengeh, coming from the direction of the sea
– US officials call them "defensive strikes" meant to limit Iran's ability to hit commercial shipping. One official said the targets were "Iranians using surface to air missiles against US assets"
– This was not a one off. WSJ reports it as the latest in a series of limited strikes over recent weeks, kept small and quiet on purpose so they would not look like a return to the full campaign
– It happened the night before the US midterms, after Trump said there would be no strikes before Tuesday
– Trump, the same day: "We had a war with Iran. We won." He added that he isn't sure you'd even call it a war "because we haven't been doing any fighting for months"
– Qatari mediators are reportedly returning to Tehran with a new proposal, and Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei called the US tone a "very good sign"
– New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said any response should be immediate and carry no "geographic limits"
– CENTCOM has not commented and there is no official Iranian response yet
– Oil barely reacted. Brent +0.5% to $105.25, WTI +0.5% to $96.93
I’ll keep you updated. Follow with notifications so you don’t miss anything this is VERY important.

这些是表外承诺，涵盖数据中心支出、未来设备采购、租赁及其他义务。

原文：BREAKING: Alphabet, $GOOGL, Meta, $META, Microsoft, $MSFT, Amazon, $AMZN, and Oracle, $ORCL, have now disclosed a record $3.3 trillion in future spending commitments.

AI 基础设施支出正推动美国银行贷款急剧增长：

这也是自 2023 年 2 月以来最大的同比增幅。
第三季度，美国前 25 大银行的工商业贷款同比增长近 10.0%，是剔除疫情相关波动后 10 年来最强劲的增长。
这与 2025 年第四季度同比收缩 8.0% 相比出现了急剧逆转。
这一激增主要由大型科技公司和数据中心开发商为 AI 基础设施项目融资而不断上升的借贷需求推动。
与此同时，地区性银行也在向建筑公司以及其他受益于这轮投资热潮的企业提供信贷。
数据中心建设越来越依赖债务融资。

原文：AI infrastructure spending is driving a sharp increase in US bank lending:
Commercial and Industrial (C&I) loans at large US banks surged +11.4% YoY in October, to $1.6 trillion, the most since June 2020.
This also marked their largest YoY growth since February 2023.
In Q3, C&I loans at the 25 largest US banks grew almost +10.0% YoY, the strongest growth in 10 years excluding pandemic-related swings.
This represents a sharp reversal from an -8.0% YoY contraction in Q4 2025.
The surge has been driven by rising borrowing demand from Big Tech companies and data-center developers to fund AI infrastructure projects.
At the same time, regional lenders are providing credit to construction companies and other businesses benefiting from the investment boom.
The data-center buildout is increasingly being funded by debt.

Brookfield 计划在英国 🇬🇧 投资 270 亿美元建设 AI 数据中心
Brookfield 正与英国能源公司 Drax 及其 AI 基础设施平台 Radiant 合作，在英格兰北约克郡的 Drax 电站开发一座超大型数据中心。
该项目总投资（含 AI 芯片）可能超过 200 亿英镑（270 亿美元），并计划最终容量超过 1 吉瓦。
开发将分阶段进行：
• 第一阶段：到 2028 年初投运最多 100 兆瓦，需投资约 25 亿英镑。
• 第二阶段：在 2028 年至 2031 年间再增加 500 兆瓦。
• 第三阶段：在 2030 年代有望扩展到 1 吉瓦以上。
关键优势在于 Drax 现有的电力基础设施，包括电网接入、土地以及生物质发电能力。
数据中心初期将从电网取电，后续阶段计划直接接入电站，让 AI 基础设施使用现场发电。
初始融资将通过 Brookfield 与卡塔尔支持的 Qai 成立的合资企业提供，Radiant 将与 Drax 共同主导开发。
该项目仍处于早期阶段，仍需获得监管批准并找到主力租户。

原文：BROOKFIELD PLANS $27B AI DATA CENTER PROJECT IN THE 🇬🇧 UK
Brookfield is partnering with British energy company Drax and its AI infrastructure platform Radiant to develop a massive data center at Drax Power Station in North Yorkshire, England.
The project could involve more than £20B ($27B) in total investment, including AI chips, with plans to eventually exceed 1 GW of capacity.
The development would take place in phases:
• Phase 1: Up to 100 MW operational by early 2028, requiring approximately £2.5B in investment.
• Phase 2: An additional 500 MW targeted between 2028 and 2031.
• Phase 3: Potential expansion beyond 1 GW in the 2030s.
The key advantage is Drax's existing power infrastructure, including its grid connection, land and biomass power generation capacity.
Initially, the data center would draw electricity from the grid. Later phases aim to connect directly to the power station, allowing AI infrastructure to access on-site electricity generation.
Initial financing would come through Brookfield's joint venture with Qatar-backed Qai, while Radiant would lead development alongside Drax.
The project remains in its early stages and still requires regulatory approvals and an anchor tenant.

Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $115B in enterprise value, combining two major suppliers of AI infrastructure and optical networking technology.
Under the agreement:
• Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares for each LITE share, implying roughly $1,132 per share.
• The offer represents a 23.9% premium to unaffected closing prices on October 28.
• Marvell shareholders will own approximately 67% of the combined company, with Lumentum shareholders holding 33%.
The deal brings together Marvell's custom AI chips, networking switches and interconnect technology with Lumentum's lasers, optical transceivers and optical circuit switching capabilities.
The bigger opportunity is the growing shift from copper to optical connectivity as AI data centers require faster data transfer, greater bandwidth and improved power efficiency.
Marvell says the combination could expand its addressable market to $550B, allowing it to offer more integrated connectivity solutions across AI data centers and within advanced chip packages.
The companies also expect:
• More than $1B in annual run-rate cost synergies.
• Improved long-term revenue growth and profit margins.
• Accretion to Marvell's adjusted EPS in the first year after closing.
Matt Murphy will remain CEO of the combined company, with the transaction expected to close in H1 2028, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
